run_crosstest_generator: run the crosstest_generator CLI to build and execute cross-architecture tests for x86, ARM, and MIPS targets
test_crosstest_generator_include_exclude: test the crosstest_generator with --include and --exclude flags to filter test attribute combinations
run_crosstest_generator_lit: run the crosstest_generator with --lit flag to generate lit test driver files for automated testing
run_crosstest_generator_defer: run the crosstest_generator with --defer flag to build all executables before executing any tests
run_crosstest_generator_print_tests: run the crosstest_generator with --print-tests flag to list all available test name attributes
